verdict.rationale: Docs confirm reviews can be triggered automatically per push and controlled per PR (qodo-docs-26), and findings can be discussed/dismissed or auto-fixed (qodo-docs-3), implying some tracking of resolved issues, but there is no explicit documentation describing incremental re-review logic that specifically avoids repeating previously raised comments across new commits. missing for 10: explicit doc/example showing re-review skips already-addressed findings and only reports new/changed issues, independent confirmation of this behavior.
